title: OCCB acquisition offer (spec Appendix F)
description: A sign-up incentive for a card: a welcome bonus, a waived fee, an intro APR or an intro earn rate. Offers are not card terms. The OCCB catalog doesn't publish them; card sites, issuers and users can, and a wallet card records the offers its holder received.

summary.description: One plain-language sentence describing the whole offer

available_from.description: First day applications qualify, when known

available_to.description: Last day applications qualify, when known

eligibility.description: Who is excluded, such as anyone who held the card in the past 48 months

accepted_on.description: In a wallet: when the holder applied or accepted the offer

earned_on.description: In a wallet: when the bonus posted, if it has

reward_max.description: bonus: the most an applicant may be offered ("as high as")

reward_cash.description: bonus: cash or a statement credit

reward_restricted_to.description: bonus: when the cash reward is a credit usable only in one place, such as a travel portal or gift card

reward_items.description: bonus: certificates or other items, such as free nights

spend_required.description: bonus: spend needed to earn it; for a tiered offer, the cumulative total

window_days.description: bonus: days from account opening to meet the spend

fee.description: fee_waiver: which fee, such as fee:annual

amount.description: fee_waiver: what is charged instead, usually $0

card_years.description: fee_waiver: the card years it covers

rate.description: intro_apr: the intro rate as a fraction, "0" for 0%

months.description: intro_apr or intro_earn: how long it lasts from account opening

transfer_fee.description: intro_apr: balance transfer fee as a fraction

categories.description: intro_earn: spend categories it applies to

multiplier.description: intro_earn: points per dollar, or percent back for cashback currencies

boost.description: intro_earn: a fraction added to all earn, such as "1" to match everything earned

stacks.description: intro_earn: adds to the card's own rate instead of replacing it

cap.description: intro_earn: spend cap over the offer's whole duration

tier.description: Orders the components of a tiered offer
